text: While resting in Latum Wetlands, Unda mentions about\nunexplored places on the mainland. Mare agrees to check them\nout too. Let's head to Div Aqua Jungle!
Monsters appear as you make your way through Div Aqua\nJungle. You are struggling and being slowed by the\nchallenging jungle terrain. Keep moving forward!
Beyond the plant wall is Vicus Mutans, a village where\nvarious tribes live together. The village elder said they\nwere all Coenubia before. Let's gather some info here first!
A horde of Coenubia is invading Vicus Mutans!\nThe villagers will be in danger if you don't do something!\nDrive the Coenubia off to save them!
As villagers succumb to the Coenubia, Nena tries to lure\nthe merman-like Coenubia into a pitfall, but it sends her\nflying. Defeat Piscruva!
